title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows | TechCrunch
summary: Google Search revenue grew 12% year over year in the third quarter, down from 17% growth in the second quarter and 19% in the first quarter. Google Cloud revenue surged 103% to $30.7 billion.
